subtechniques.title: Many
templates: Rhetorically bombarding (person) with remarks, ranging from ('rhetorical 1') to ('rhetorical 2') to ('rhetorical 3'), (author) (adverb verb) the importance of ...
examples: Rhetorically bombarding residents with remarks, ranging from ‘how will you afford a house?’ to ‘are you really trying?’ to ‘don’t your kids need you?’, Khaled pointedly accentuates the importance of easing the housing crisis …

subtechniques.title: Single
templates: Rhetorically questioning ('rhetorical q'), (author) seeks to (adverb verb) the ...
examples: Rhetorically questioning ‘can you survive without food?’, Seif seeks to pointedly accentuate the damaging effects of the housing crisis and cost of living.
Rhetorically questioning ‘how would it feel like to be homeless?’, Haseeb seeks to pointedly accentuate that homelessness is an ill experience that no person would feel inclined to feel.
